# processes

The ten product catalogue business processes PC-BP-01 to PC-BP-10 as BPMN 2.0 diagrams, and their DMN decision tables under decisions/. They describe how people work; agents do not run them.

Part of [Digital Transformation Handbook for Health Product Catalogue](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `processes`, holding `business-processes`.
